title: Boscombe Surf Reef - The Story
relevance_evidence: Whole 5-min piece is a mini-documentary on the reef: 'Here's the story of how, where and why it was built' (description); transcript covers history, structure, construction, size/position, wave mechanics, marine life.

segments.what: Intro: Europe's first artificial surf reef, GBP 11m regeneration scheme (narration)
segments.quote: home to Europe's first artificial surf Reef thanks to an 11 million pound regeneration scheme

segments.what: Project history: idea first raised 1999, car park sold to finance it, government permission 2007
segments.quote: Bournemouth burough Council sold an underused car park to finance the scheme

segments.what: Structure explained: base layer, top layer and ramp; each = webbing base + geotextile bags
segments.quote: each layer consists of two elements a webbing base and huge geotextile bags

segments.what: Prefabrication on a field, section concertina-folded by cranes onto a barge
segments.quote: the section was then concertina by huge cranes and laid onto a barge

segments.what: Aug 2008 deployment just east of Boscombe Pier: divers anchor section, barge unrolls it, bags sand-filled; largest bags 70 x 2 x 6 m
segments.quote: the largest bags were 70 M long 2 m high and 6 M wide

segments.what: Base layer done 2008, winter stop, top layer and ramp laid autumn 2009
segments.quote: in the Autumn the top layer and ramp was laid and filled

segments.what: Size, position and hydraulics: football-pitch size, 250 m offshore, acts as a ramp not a wave machine
segments.quote: it's the size of a football pitch and positioned 250 M offshore

segments.what: Surf use (right-handers, RNLI cover) and marine life on the reef
segments.quote: a variety of species now live on the reef including crabs Lobster pipe fish seab bass and mullet

segments.what: Regeneration outcome: 60-country coverage, new businesses, ~80 seafront jobs
segments.quote: around 80 jobs have been created along the seafront alone

title: Boscombe Surf Reef the construction story so far
relevance_evidence: Pure construction video (BoscombeReef channel, Jul 2009, empty description): materials from NZ, three stitched base sections, barge deployment, divers, sand filling. Previously metadata-only; now transcribed. NOTE: says the FIRST base section is 'approximately the size of a football pitch', whereas F0PslWKkbf4 says the whole reef is football-pitch sized.

segments.what: Materials shipped from New Zealand; reef base made of three separate triple-stitched sections
segments.quote: the base of the Sur reath is formed from three separate sections

segments.what: Bags tied to webbing base with 1,000+ ties; first base section ~football-pitch size, folded for transport
segments.quote: the first section of the reef base layer is approximately the size of a football pitch

segments.what: 10-tonne section lifted onto a barge
segments.quote: the section weighs 10 tons and so lifting is a delicate process

segments.what: Barge to site 250 m from Boscombe beach; section unfolded on the seabed; divers attach webbing to anchors
segments.quote: the site of the reef just 250 M from boson Beach Shoreline

segments.what: Bags filled one by one with beach sand via a 300 m pipeline; 1-4 hours per bag
segments.quote: a 300 M pipeline transports the sand out to sea where divers attach the pipes to the bags
